name: @graphty/graph-io-fidelity
description: Side-by-side Storybook of graph-io's style fidelity samples: each source program's own picture, graphty-element drawing the file with its file styles, and the per-property scorecard
author: Adam Powers <apowers@ato.ms>

scripts.storybook: storybook dev -p ${PORT:?start it through servherd, which sets PORT} --host ${HOST:-localhost} ${HTTPS_CERT_PATH:+--https --ssl-cert $HTTPS_CERT_PATH --ssl-key $HTTPS_KEY_PATH} --no-open
